How do you confirm your suspected diagnosis and what is the expected finding? *EEG. It is particularly important to capture sleep (higher yield). Early EEG can be falsely reassuring and may need to be repeated if clinically concerned. Looking for characteristic hypsarrythmia pattern.*

Why should this be treated early? *Higher risk of neurodevelopmental sequela if not treated early. Every 2 weeks of delayed treatment leads to a 4 point drop in VABS (Vineland Adaptive Behavior Scale) scores at 4 years*
